items.source: Returns all methods considered to be query methods.
items.translation: 返回所有被视为查询方法的方法。

items.source: Returns the base class to be used to create the proxy backing instance.
items.translation: 返回用于创建代理后备实例的基类。

items.source: Returns whether the configured repository interface has query methods at all.
items.translation: 返回配置的存储库接口是否包含任何查询方法。

items.source: Returns whether the given method is a custom repository method.
items.translation: 返回给定的方法是否为自定义仓储方法。

items.source: Returns whether the given method is a query method.
items.translation: 返回给定的方法是否为查询方法。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryComposition for this repository.
items.translation: 返回此仓库的RepositoryComposition。

items.source: Returns the target class method that is backing the given method. This can be necessary if a repository interface redeclares a method of the core repository interface (e.g. for transaction behavior customization). Returns the method itself if the target class does not implement the given method. Implementations need to make sure the Method returned can be invoked via reflection, i.e. needs to be accessible.
items.translation: 返回给定方法所对应的目标类方法。如果存储库接口重新声明了核心存储库接口的某个方法（例如用于事务行为自定义），则此操作可能是必要的。如果目标类未实现给定方法，则返回该方法本身。实现需要确保通过反射可以调用返回的Method，即该方法是可访问的。

items.source: Returns the RepositoryComposition for this repository. This is used to determine the composition of the repository and its fragments.
items.translation: 返回此仓库的RepositoryComposition。该对象用于确定仓库及其片段的组成情况。

items.source: Returns the target class method that is backing the given method.
items.translation: 返回给定方法所对应的目标类方法。

items.source:
Returns if the configured repository interface has custom methods, that might have to be delegated to a custom
implementation.
items.translation: 如果配置的仓库接口包含可能需要委托给自定义实现的自定义方法，则返回 true。

items.source: Returns whether the given method is logically a base class method.
items.translation: 返回给定的方法在逻辑上是否为基类方法。

items.source:
Returns whether the given method is logically a base class method. This also includes methods (re)declared in the
repository interface that match the signatures of the base implementation.
items.translation: 返回给定的方法在逻辑上是否为基类方法。这还包括在存储库接口中（重新）声明且与基实现签名匹配的方法。

items.source:
Returns if the configured repository interface has custom methods, that might have to be delegated to a custom
implementation. This is used to verify repository configuration.
items.translation: 如果配置的存储库接口包含可能需要委派给自定义实现的自定义方法，则返回 true。此功能用于验证存储库配置。
